%% hello.erl
%% 编译运行：erlc hello.erl && erl -noshell -s hello main -s init stop
-module(hello).
-export([main/0]).

main() ->
    io:format("Hello, World!~n"),
    %% 变量必须大写开头，= 是模式匹配而不是赋值
    Name = <<"Erlang">>,
    io:format("你好, ~ts~n", [Name]),
    %% 启动一个轻量进程，向它发送消息
    Pid = spawn(fun() ->
        receive
            {greet, From, Who} -> From ! {ok, "你好, " ++ Who}
        end
    end),
    Pid ! {greet, self(), "OTP"},
    receive
        {ok, Msg} -> io:format("~ts~n", [Msg])
    end.
ec: 把 = 当成赋值并试图修改变量，如 X = 1, X = 2 会直接 badmatch 崩溃。Erlang 的变量只能绑定一次，需要新值时必须换一个新变量名，这正是无共享状态的基础。

-module(operators).
-export([main/0]).

main() ->
    io:format("7 / 2 = ~p~n", [7 / 2]),
    io:format("7 div 2 = ~p~n", [7 div 2]),
    io:format("7 rem 2 = ~p~n", [7 rem 2]),

    %% == 宽松比较，=:= 严格比较
    io:format("1 == 1.0 -> ~p~n", [1 == 1.0]),
    io:format("1 =:= 1.0 -> ~p~n", [1 =:= 1.0]),

    %% andalso/orelse 短路：右侧不会求值
    false = false andalso (1 div 0 > 1),
    true = true orelse (1 div 0 > 1),
    io:format("短路生效~n"),

    %% 位运算
    io:format("1 bsl 10 = ~p~n", [1 bsl 10]),
    io:format("255 band 15 = ~p~n", [255 band 15]).

    io:put_chars(IoList).

-module(recursion).
-export([main/0, sum/1, sum_tail/1]).

%% 非尾递归：栈随长度增长
sum([]) -> 0;
sum([H | T]) -> H + sum(T).

%% 尾递归：累加器 Acc
sum_tail(List) -> sum_tail(List, 0).
sum_tail([], Acc) -> Acc;
sum_tail([H | T], Acc) -> sum_tail(T, Acc + H).

main() ->
    Nums = lists:seq(1, 100),
    io:format("sum = ~p~n", [sum(Nums)]),
    io:format("sum_tail = ~p~n", [sum_tail(Nums)]),

    %% 高阶函数：foldl 实现求和
    Total = lists:foldl(fun(X, Acc) -> X + Acc end, 0, Nums),
    io:format("foldl = ~p~n", [Total]),

    %% 闭包捕获 Factor
    Factor = 3,
    Times = fun(X) -> X * Factor end,
    io:format("~p~n", [lists:map(Times, [1, 2, 3])]).
ec: 手写递归时把累加结果放在递归调用之后，如 H + sum(T)，长列表会耗尽栈。应改为尾递归加累加器，让 BEAM 复用栈帧，或在标准库中直接使用 foldl。

-module(functions).
-export([main/0, fact/1, greet/1, max_of/2]).

%% 阶乘：两个子句，递归到 0
fact(0) -> 1;
fact(N) when N > 0 -> N * fact(N - 1).

%% 守卫分流，覆盖所有输入
greet(Name) when is_binary(Name) -> <<"你好, ", Name/binary>>;
greet(Name) when is_list(Name) -> "你好, " ++ Name;
greet(_) -> <<"你好, 陌生人">>.

%% 多参数与守卫
max_of(A, B) when A >= B -> A;
max_of(_, B) -> B.

main() ->
    io:format("5! = ~p~n", [fact(5)]),
    io:format("~ts~n", [greet(<<"Ada">>)]),
    io:format("~p~n", [max_of(3, 9)]).

-module(higher_order).
-export([main/0, compose/2, apply_all/2]).

%% 返回一个组合函数：先 F 后 G
compose(F, G) ->
    fun(X) -> G(F(X)) end.

apply_all(Funs, Value) ->
    lists:map(fun(F) -> F(Value) end, Funs).

main() ->
    Inc = fun(X) -> X + 1 end,
    Double = fun(X) -> X * 2 end,
    IncThenDouble = compose(Inc, Double),
    io:format("~p~n", [IncThenDouble(5)]),

    Funs = [Inc, Double, fun(X) -> X * X end],
    io:format("~p~n", [apply_all(Funs, 4)]),

    %% 闭包捕获 Base
    Base = 100,
    AddBase = fun(X) -> X + Base end,
    io:format("~p~n", [lists:map(AddBase, [1, 2, 3])]),
    %% 外部函数引用
    io:format("~p~n", [lists:sort(fun(A, B) -> A >= B end, [3, 1, 2])]).

-module(matching).
-export([main/0, parse/1, dispatch/1]).

%% 解析常见返回结构
parse({ok, #{status := Status, body := Body}}) ->
    {Status, Body};
parse({error, Reason}) ->
    {error, Reason};
parse(_) ->
    {error, unexpected}.

%% 二进制协议：4 字节长度 + 负载 + 剩余
dispatch(<<Len:32/big, Payload:Len/binary, Rest/binary>>) ->
    {Payload, Rest};
dispatch(_) ->
    incomplete.
main() ->
    io:format("~p~n", [parse({ok, #{status => 200, body => <<"hi">>}})]),
    io:format("~p~n", [parse({error, timeout})]),
    Bin = <<0, 0, 0, 3, "abc", "tail">>,
    {Payload, Rest} = dispatch(Bin),
    io:format("payload=~p rest=~p~n", [Payload, Rest]),
    %% 列表头尾拆分
    [First, Second | Tail] = [1, 2, 3, 4],
    io:format("~p ~p ~p~n", [First, Second, Tail]).

-export([main/0, start_link/0, fetch/0, store/1]).

-export_type([counter/0]).

new() -> 0.

safe_div(_A, 0) -> {error, division_by_zero};
safe_div(A, B) -> {ok, A / B}.

    catch

    %% 逐行读取

    end.

-module(regex).
-export([main/0, extract_emails/1, normalize/1]).

extract_emails(Text) ->
    {ok, Re} = re:compile("[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"),
    case re:run(Text, Re, [global, {capture, first, binary}]) of
        {match, Matches} -> [M || [M] <- Matches];
        nomatch -> []
    end.

normalize(Text) ->
    re:replace(Text, "\\s+", " ", [global, {return, binary}]).

main() ->
    Text = <<"联系 ada@example.com 或 bob@test.org 获取帮助">>,
    io:format("~p~n", [extract_emails(Text)]),
    io:format("~ts~n", [normalize(<<"hello   world\n\tagain">>)]),

    %% 捕获组（all_but_first 不包含整体匹配）
    {match, [Year, Month]} = re:run("2026-11-15", "(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})",
                                    [{capture, all_but_first, list}]),
    io:format("~s 年 ~s 月~n", [Year, Month]).
ec: 在普通字符串里写 \d+ 时少写一个反斜杠，结果 Erlang 把 \d 解析为字母 d，正则永远匹配不到数字。正则中的反斜杠必须写成 \\，或改用二进制模式串。

-module(concurrency).
-export([main/0]).

worker(Parent) ->
    receive
        {compute, N} -> Parent ! {result, N * N}, worker(Parent);
        stop -> Parent ! done
    after 5000 -> Parent ! timeout
    end.

main() ->
    Parent = self(),
    Pid = spawn(fun() -> worker(Parent) end),
    Pid ! {compute, 7},
    receive {result, R} -> io:format("结果: ~p~n", [R]) end,

    %% 并发跑多个任务并收集全部结果
    Pids = [spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {done, self(), N * 10} end)
            || N <- lists:seq(1, 5)],
    Results = [receive {done, P, V} -> V end || P <- Pids],
    io:format("汇总: ~p~n", [lists:sum(Results)]),

    Pid ! stop,
    receive done -> io:format("worker 已退出~n") end.
ec: 在 receive 里写了没有 after 的分支，发送方崩溃后接收进程永久挂起。任何等待消息的地方都应设置合理的 after 超时，并返回 {error, timeout} 交由上层决策。

-module(perf).
-export([main/0, build_bin/1, build_list/1]).

%% 二进制累积，构造开销低
build_bin(N) ->
    iolist_to_binary([integer_to_binary(I) || I <- lists:seq(1, N)]).

%% 列表 ++ 在长循环中代价高
build_list(N) ->
    lists:foldl(fun(I, Acc) -> Acc ++ integer_to_list(I) end, "", lists:seq(1, N)).

main() ->
    {T1, B} = timer:tc(fun() -> build_bin(5000) end),
    {T2, L} = timer:tc(fun() -> build_list(5000) end),
    io:format("二进制 ~p 字节, ~p us~n", [byte_size(B), T1]),
    io:format("列表 ~p 字符, ~p us~n", [length(L), T2]),

    %% ETS 并发读写
    Tab = ets:new(cache, [set, public, {read_concurrency, true}]),
    ets:insert(Tab, {key, value}),
    io:format("ETS: ~p~n", [ets:lookup(Tab, key)]),
    io:format("进程内存: ~p~n", [element(2, process_info(self(), memory))]),
    ets:delete(Tab).

p: OTP 把系统拆成监督树：application 管顶层 supervisor，supervisor 管子进程，故障在局部重启
gen_server 封装状态与消息循环，对外只暴露函数 API，调用方不直接发原始消息
把纯计算与副作用分离：纯函数易测试，进程/文件/网络等副作用集中在边界层
进程按业务实体划分，用注册名或 via 元组定位，避免全局单点瓶颈
c:
-module(kv_store).
-behaviour(gen_server).
-export([main/0, start_link/0, store/2, fetch/1]).
-export([init/1, handle_call/3, handle_cast/2, handle_info/2, terminate/2]).

start_link() -> gen_server:start_link({local, ?MODULE}, ?MODULE, [], []).
store(K, V) -> gen_server:call(?MODULE, {put, K, V}).
fetch(K) -> gen_server:call(?MODULE, {get, K}).

init([]) -> {ok, #{}}.

handle_call({put, K, V}, _From, State) ->
    {reply, ok, maps:put(K, V, State)};
handle_call({get, K}, _From, State) ->
    {reply, maps:find(K, State), State}.

handle_cast(_Msg, State) -> {noreply, State}.
handle_info(_Info, State) -> {noreply, State}.
terminate(_Reason, _State) -> ok.
main() ->
    {ok, _} = start_link(),
    ok = store(a, 1),
    ok = store(b, 2),
    io:format("~p~n", [fetch(a)]),
    io:format("注册进程: ~p~n", [whereis(?MODULE)]).
ec: 让 gen_server 承担所有业务逻辑，handle_call 里做 HTTP 请求或大数据计算，导致调用方全部阻塞。回调应只维护状态，耗时工作交给工作进程或异步任务。

p: mnesia 是 OTP 内置分布式数据库，表可存于 ram_copies/disc_copies，支持事务与脏读写
关系型数据库用 epgsql（PostgreSQL）或 mysql-otp，通过连接池（如 poolboy）复用连接
写操作优先走事务 mnesia:transaction/1，只读且可容忍短暂不一致时用 dirty_read/2 提速
把数据库访问封装在仓储模块中，业务层只依赖接口，便于替换实现与用 meck 做测试替身
c:
-module(db_demo).
-export([main/0]).
-record(person, {id, name, age}).

main() ->
    ok = mnesia:start(),
    {atomic, ok} = mnesia:create_table(person,
        [{attributes, record_info(fields, person)}, {ram_copies, [node()]}]),
    %% 事务写入
    {atomic, ok} = mnesia:transaction(fun() ->
        mnesia:write(#person{id = 1, name = <<"Ada">>, age = 36}),
        mnesia:write(#person{id = 2, name = <<"Linus">>, age = 54})
    end),
    %% 主键读取
    {atomic, [P]} = mnesia:transaction(fun() -> mnesia:read(person, 1) end),
    io:format("~p~n", [P#person.name]),
    %% 脏读（无事务开销）
    io:format("~p~n", [mnesia:dirty_read(person, 2)]),
    %% 按条件查询
    {atomic, Adults} = mnesia:transaction(fun() ->
        mnesia:select(person, [{#person{age = '$1', _ = '_'},
                                [{'>=', '$1', 18}], ['$_']}])
    end),
    io:format("成年人: ~p~n", [length(Adults)]),
    mnesia:stop().
ec: 在 mnesia 事务里调用外部 HTTP 或长时间计算，事务持有锁期间阻塞其他写入。事务体应只包含数据库操作，外部副作用放到事务外，失败时再补偿或重试。

p: gen_tcp 提供 TCP 服务端与客户端：listen/2、accept/1、send/2、recv/2，配合 {active, once} 接收数据
inets 应用自带 httpc 客户端，可发起 GET/POST 并处理 JSON；生产环境常用 hackney 或 gun
构建 HTTP 服务常用 cowboy（轻量、支持 HTTP/2 与 WebSocket），路由与处理器分离
网络操作必须设置超时与重试上限，并处理连接重置、DNS 失败等异常

-module(netdemo).
-export([main/0, start_server/1]).
start_server(Port) ->
    {ok, LSock} = gen_tcp:listen(Port, [binary, {packet, line}, {reuseaddr, true}]),
    {ok, {_Addr, Actual}} = inet:sockname(LSock),
    spawn(fun() -> accept_loop(LSock) end),
    {ok, Actual}.
accept_loop(LSock) ->
    {ok, Sock} = gen_tcp:accept(LSock),
    spawn(fun() -> handle(Sock) end),
    accept_loop(LSock).
handle(Sock) ->
    case gen_tcp:recv(Sock, 0, 5000) of
        {ok, Line} ->
            gen_tcp:send(Sock, <<"echo: ", Line/binary>>),
            handle(Sock);
        {error, _} ->
            gen_tcp:close(Sock)
    end.
main() ->
    {ok, Port} = start_server(0),
    {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(inets),
    {ok, {{_, 200, _}, _, _}} =
        httpc:request(get, {"https://example.com", []}, [{timeout, 5000}], []),
    io:format("HTTP 请求成功, 本地端口 ~p~n", [Port]).
ec: 用 {active, true} 让 socket 无限制地把数据推入进程邮箱，客户端狂发时内存暴涨。应使用 {active, once} 并在每次处理后重新设置，形成天然背压。

p: binary_to_term/1 处理不可信数据时使用 [safe] 选项，避免原子耗尽与恶意 term 构造
密码存储用 crypto:hash(sha256, ...) 加盐，或使用 bcrypt/argon2 库，绝不明文保存
Erlang 分布式节点必须设置相同 cookie 并配合 TLS 与防火墙，cookie 等同集群口令
外部输入先校验长度、类型与范围，SQL 用参数化查询，日志中避免输出敏感字段
c:
-module(security).
-export([main/0, safe_decode/1, hash_password/2, valid_username/1]).

safe_decode(Bin) ->
    try binary_to_term(Bin, [safe]) of
        Term -> {ok, Term}
    catch
        error:badarg -> {error, unsafe_or_invalid}
    end.

hash_password(Password, Salt) ->
    crypto:hash(sha256, <<Salt/binary, Password/binary>>).

valid_username(Name) when is_binary(Name) ->
    byte_size(Name) >= 3 andalso byte_size(Name) =< 32 andalso
        re:run(Name, "^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$", [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_username(_) -> false.

main() ->
    io:format("~p~n", [safe_decode(term_to_binary({ok, 1}))]),
    io:format("~p~n", [safe_decode(<<"not a term">>)]),
    io:format("hash: ~p~n", [hash_password(<<"s3cret">>, <<"random-salt">>)]),
    io:format("~p ~p~n", [valid_username(<<"ada_99">>), valid_username(<<"a!">>)]).
ec: 直接对来自网络的二进制调用 binary_to_term/1，攻击者可构造海量原子或超大结构打爆内存。必须加 [safe] 选项，并对输入长度设上限后再解码。

p: escript 把 Erlang 源码打包成可直接执行的脚本，首行 shebang 指定 escript，main/1 接收参数列表
参数解析可手写模式匹配，也可用 getopt；错误时打印用法到 standard_error 并以非零码退出
halts/1 控制退出码，0 表示成功，非 0 表示失败，便于 shell 管道与 CI 判断
处理大文件用 file:open + 分块读取，统计结果用 map 聚合，最后排序输出
c:
#!/usr/bin/env escript
%% wordcount.escript
%% 运行：chmod +x wordcount.escript && ./wordcount.escript README.md
-mode(compile).

main([Path]) ->
    case file:read_file(Path) of
        {ok, Bin} ->
            Text = unicode:characters_to_list(Bin),
            Counts = lists:foldl(fun(W, Acc) ->
                         maps:update_with(W, fun(N) -> N + 1 end, 1, Acc)
                     end, #{}, string:lexemes(Text, " \t\r\n")),
            Sorted = lists:reverse(lists:keysort(2, maps:to_list(Counts))),
            lists:foreach(fun({W, N}) ->
                          io:format("~-20s ~p~n", [W, N])
                      end, lists:sublist(Sorted, 10));
        {error, Reason} ->
            io:format(standard_error, "读取失败: ~p~n", [Reason]),
            halt(1)
    end;
main(_) ->
    io:format(standard_error, "用法: wordcount.escript <文件>~n", []),
    halt(2).
ec: escript 里忘了写 -mode(compile)，复杂逻辑按解释执行慢一个数量级；或在 main/1 中直接 halt 而不返回，导致管道下游拿不到输出。应编译模式运行并先输出再退出。

p: 最小 HTTP 服务可用 gen_tcp 实现：读取请求行、按路径返回响应、写回 Connection: close
响应需包含状态行、Content-Length、Content-Type 与空行，再发送 body，客户端才不会挂起
生产项目用 cowboy：路由到 handler，init/2 返回 {ok, Req, State}，再用 cowboy_req:reply 响应
把监听与业务处理拆成独立进程，accept 循环只负责接收，避免慢请求阻塞新连接

-module(webserver).
-export([start/1]).

start(Port) ->
    {ok, LSock} = gen_tcp:listen(Port, [binary, {packet, http_bin},
                                        {reuseaddr, true}, {active, false}]),
    spawn(fun() -> loop(LSock) end),
    {ok, Port}.
loop(LSock) ->
    {ok, Sock} = gen_tcp:accept(LSock),
    spawn(fun() -> handle(Sock) end),
    loop(LSock).
handle(Sock) ->
    {ok, {http_request, Method, {abs_path, Path}, _}} = gen_tcp:recv(Sock, 0, 5000),
    Body = case {Method, Path} of
               {'GET', <<"/">>} -> <<"{\"message\":\"hello erlang\"}">>;
               {'GET', <<"/health">>} -> <<"{\"status\":\"ok\"}">>;
               _ -> <<"{\"error\":\"not found\"}">>
           end,
    Code = case Path of <<"/health">> -> <<"200 OK">>; <<"/">> -> <<"200 OK">>; _ -> <<"404 Not Found">> end,
    Resp = [<<"HTTP/1.1 ">>, Code, <<"\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n">>,
            <<"Content-Length: ">>, integer_to_binary(byte_size(Body)),
            <<"\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n">>, Body],
    gen_tcp:send(Sock, Resp),
    gen_tcp:close(Sock).
ec: 响应里漏写 Content-Length 又保持连接不关闭，浏览器会一直等待直到超时。每个响应都应带准确长度并显式关闭连接，或用 chunked 编码并正确结束。

p: rebar3 release 基于 relx 生成自包含发布包，包含 ERTS、依赖与启动脚本，目标机无需装 Erlang
relx 配置在 rebar.config 的 {relx, [...]}，定义 release 名称、版本、包含的应用与 vm.args
用 tar 打包发布目录，配合 systemd 管理服务，设置 Restart=on-failure 与优雅停止
热升级用 relup 与 release_handler，需谨慎演练；多数场景滚动重启更简单可靠

%%         {extended_start_script, true}]}.
%% 构建：rebar3 as prod release

-module(release_info).
-export([main/0]).

main() ->
    io:format("rebar3 as prod release -> _build/prod/rel/my_app~n"),
    io:format("启动脚本: bin/my_app {foreground|start|stop|restart}~n"),
    io:format("配置文件: releases/<vsn>/sys.config 与 vm.args~n"),
    io:format("systemd: Restart=on-failure, KillSignal=SIGTERM~n"),
    io:format("节点: ~p~n", [node()]),
    io:format("OTP: ~s~n", [erlang:system_info(otp_release)]),
    io:format("代码路径数: ~p~n", [length(code:get_path())]).

p: 每个导出函数写 -spec，公共模块写 -type/-opaque，配合 dialyzer 在 CI 中阻断类型回归
函数保持短小，单函数不超过一屏；用子句与守卫表达分支，避免深层 case 嵌套
进程必须有监督者，崩溃要能自动恢复；不在 gen_server 回调里做阻塞操作
命名用 snake_case，模块名体现职责；日志用 logger 结构化字段，禁止在库中 print 调试

-module(best_practice).
-export([main/0, fetch_user/1]).
-export_type([user/0]).
-type user() :: #{id := pos_integer(), name := binary()}.
-type result(T) :: {ok, T} | {error, atom()}.
-spec fetch_user(pos_integer()) -> result(user()).
fetch_user(Id) when is_integer(Id), Id > 0 ->
    Users = #{1 => #{id => 1, name => <<"Ada">>},
              2 => #{id => 2, name => <<"Linus">>}},
    case maps:find(Id, Users) of
        {ok, User} -> {ok, User};
        error -> {error, not_found}
    end;
fetch_user(_) ->
    {error, invalid_id}.
main() ->
    lists:foreach(fun(Id) ->
                  case fetch_user(Id) of
                      {ok, #{name := Name}} ->
                          io:format("~p -> ~ts~n", [Id, Name]);
                      {error, Reason} ->
                          logger:warning("fetch_user failed", #{id => Id, reason => Reason})
                  end
              end, [1, 2, 99]),
    io:format("dialyzer 检查建议加入 CI~n").
